acceptance: prompt --role reviewer accepts --ref <branch or commit> exactly as review-packet and review record do, so a reviewer prompt for a node without a registry claim (including a Complete node) is generated without a workaround

handoff status exits 0 when the node is Complete with no claim and reports state complete_no_claim (text and --json); exit 1 means the gate is not met; a distinct exit code (2) means the gate cannot be determined, and the JSON state field names which
specy-road review list <ID> [--ref] is read-only: it prints the filed review records with verdict, commit and family, then the current gate evaluation, and never re-validates or writes

init project writes a minimal valid roadmap/orchestration.yaml starter (commented, one human and one executor entry, default policy) and validate --generate-orchestration writes the same file when none exists, replacing the silent default with an editable file
nodes.title: Read-only review commands take --ref, handoff status exit codes are distinct, review list, and an orchestration.yaml starter
